concept.name: Primanti Bros.
concept.tagline: Sandwiches and fries in Central Oakland, Pittsburgh

menu.name: Pastrami Sandwich
menu.description: Sliced pastrami on grilled Italian bread with coleslaw, tomato, and melted cheese, with fries packed right inside.
menu.imagePrompt: A stacked pastrami sandwich with coleslaw, tomato, and fries spilling from the bread, in a white paper takeout wrapper on a wooden tray, warm lighting, no text, no people.

menu.name: Classic Cheesesteak Sandwich
menu.description: Thinly sliced grilled steak with melted cheese, onions, and tomato on a soft roll, with coleslaw and fries inside.
menu.imagePrompt: A cheesesteak sandwich with melted cheese, grilled onions, and fries visible in the bread, wrapped in white paper on a takeout tray, no text, no people.

menu.name: Chicken Cutlet Sandwich
menu.description: Breaded and fried chicken cutlet on Italian bread with coleslaw, tomato, and fries.
menu.imagePrompt: A crispy fried chicken cutlet sandwich with coleslaw and fries inside, in a paper wrapper on a takeout tray, no text, no people.

menu.name: Italian Sausage Sandwich
menu.description: Grilled Italian sausage with peppers and onions on a roll, topped with fries and coleslaw.
menu.imagePrompt: A grilled sausage sandwich with peppers, onions, and fries in a paper takeout wrapper, no text, no people.

menu.name: Veggie Sandwich
menu.description: Grilled vegetables, cheese, tomato, and coleslaw on Italian bread with fries inside.
menu.imagePrompt: A vegetable sandwich with grilled peppers, tomato, cheese, and fries inside a paper wrapper, no text, no people.

menu.name: Fries Side
menu.description: Crispy french fries, served by themselves.
menu.imagePrompt: A paper cup of golden french fries on a takeout tray, no text, no people.

menu.name: Soft Drink
menu.description: Fountain soda in a cup with ice.
menu.imagePrompt: A plastic cup of soda with ice and a straw on a takeout tray, no text, no people.

brand.logoPrompt: A flat two-color mark: a simple stacked sandwich with fries tucked inside, in mustard yellow on cream, with the name set in a bold sans-serif beneath.
brand.voice: Friendly and straightforward, like a neighborhood sandwich counter that is glad to see you and gets your order right.
